workflow: Event-driven parameter updates to task routing

feasibility_check: Verification agent: review; operator: startup approval

title: Bridging High-Level Intent and Network Execution: Detecting Violations and Intent Drift Through Low-Level Traffic Analysis
workflow: Offline port-policy compliance and drift monitoring

workflow: Intent profiles to O1 assurance counters
workflow_detail: RAN management/assurance over O1. Intent categories map to resource profiles; aggregate performance counters determine fulfillment/degradation.

title: Distilling Knowledge from Large Language Models into Lightweight Reinforcement Learning Agents for Autonomous Cyber Operations
workflow_detail: Network defense policy. A language-model teacher and distilled PPO student choose network isolation/restoration actions in CybORG.

title: Learning Not to Optimize: Physics-Informed Action-Space Reshaping for Intent-Based Network Control
feasibility_check: Executor: exact residual check and repair/fallback
coverage_check: Guard: no executable generated candidate; fallback
workflow_detail: Candidate-set guard; network deployment selector. Residual screening, symmetry quotienting, and dominance filtering form a frontier before action selection.
feasibility_detail: Executor recomputes exact network-law residuals; invalid selected actions are rejected, repaired, or mapped to fallback.
coverage_detail: An empty executable set among generated candidates triggers fallback. The paper separates finite-generation coverage loss from screening correctness.
evidence_note: Screening certifies members of the generated candidate set.

title: NetConfArena: An Executable Benchmark for LLM Agents in Closed-Loop Network Configuration
workflow: Interactive CLI changes scored in emulation
workflow_detail: Interactive network configuration agent. Agents produce and submit device CLI changes in an emulated network; task predicates score the resulting behavior.
evidence_note: Negative tests cover the benchmark's stated prohibitions.

title: Uncertainty Signals for Network Intent Translation: Risk Ranking and Ambiguity Localization
workflow_detail: Intent translator; uncertainty-based review selector. Juniper command candidates are ranked by uncertainty for abstention/review; token entropy locates ambiguity.
evidence_note: Uncertainty scores determine candidate ranking and abstention.

title: On Identifying Adversarial Intent Injection in AI-Native 6G Networks
workflow_detail: Intent security filter. A classifier marks an intent sequence window malicious when attack content is detected.
evidence_note: Evaluation uses synthetic attack-intent windows.

title: NetInspector: Measuring and Improving LLM Capabilities for Reliable Intent-Based Networking Policy Generation
workflow: Intent translation to tool-based policy inspection
feasibility_check: Tools: network predicates; LLM: final verdict
workflow_detail: Intent translator; policy-inspection agent. Entity prefiltering narrows policies; a tool-using agent queries network facts and returns Conflict or Safe.
observation_detail: A dedicated state manager versions and applies updates atomically so each query sees a consistent network snapshot.
feasibility_detail: Deterministic tools resolve groups and query reachability, middleboxes, rule priorities, bandwidth, and temporal overlap; the LLM combines the replies into a terminal verdict.
evidence_note: Each query reads a consistent snapshot; the LLM assembles tool replies into the final verdict.

title: TelecomGPT-R1: Unified Post-Training for Reasoning Across Heterogeneous Telecom Tasks
workflow_detail: Telecom diagnostic assistant. TeleLogs inputs produce a fault-class choice with supporting reasoning.
evidence_note: Rule/answer checks are used in training-data construction.

title: From Intents to Algorithms: Verified Algorithm Discovery for Transport Networks
workflow: Numerical algorithm search to path allocation
workflow_detail: Intent compiler; transport algorithm search and allocator. Conceptual LLM/AST discovery is separated from measured numerical ranking-function evolution and deterministic path allocation.
feasibility_detail: Trusted network functions retain capacity, latency, path-validity, and single-path feasibility; discovered algorithms rank alternatives without redefining those constraints.
evidence_note: Evaluation covers the ten-parameter numerical search; free algorithm generation remains proposed.

title: Intent2Tc: Automated Intent-to-Traffic Control Translation with Language Models
workflow: Intent compilation to corrected traffic-shaping rules
feasibility_check: Fixed-template module: policy and tc constraints
workflow_detail: Traffic-shaping intent compiler. Language models produce metadata, declarative sub-intents, and Linux tc rules; deterministic correction intervenes between stages.
feasibility_detail: A template-based correction module enforces scoped policy consistency and tc hierarchy, priority, filtering, and syntax constraints.
evidence_note: Template correction applies a fixed traffic semantic model.

title: Automatic Intent-Based Secure Service Creation Through a Multilayer SDN Network Orchestration
workflow: Multilayer SDN service setup and teardown
workflow_detail: Multilayer SDN service orchestrator. Encryption/domain constraints select a layer and installation plan, followed by connection setup or teardown.
evidence_note: Encryption, path provisioning, installation acknowledgements, and teardown have separate responsibilities and timing endpoints.

title: Cross-stakeholder service orchestration for B5G through capability provisioning
workflow_detail: Domain/capability/cross-domain service orchestrators (conceptual). Business goals map to domain configuration, capability/SLA instances, and end-to-end provider combinations.
evidence_note: The architecture specifies three functional transformations; decision-interface implementations are unspecified.

title: NetOrchLLM: Mastering Wireless Network Orchestration with Large Language Models
workflow: Wireless tool selection and allocation generation
workflow_detail: Wireless model/tool orchestrator. Task/model selection and function calls support constructed bandwidth and multiuser power-allocation vectors.
evidence_note: Selecting a model/tool and constructing its numerical allocation output are distinct interfaces.

title: An Autonomous Network Orchestration Framework Integrating Large Language Models with Continual Reinforcement Learning
workflow: Semantic objectives to sequential resource actions
observation_check: Controller updates state after each allocation
workflow_detail: Network orchestration controller. Semantic objective/QoE decisions and user sequencing feed RL placement, capacity, and path allocation.
observation_detail: State history is updated after each user allocation before subsequent users are processed.
feasibility_detail: Per-user/service state masking restricts the action executor to the represented feasible space.
evidence_note: The model constructs a user ordering and selects resource actions. Feasibility depends on the represented infrastructure and mask.

title: KP-A: A Unified Network Knowledge Plane for Catalyzing Agentic Network Intelligence
workflow_detail: Network knowledge/query plane; edge-service agent. Live/static knowledge endpoints support state answers, service recommendations, and subscription creation.
evidence_note: The prototype demonstrates live queries; freshness and versioning are design requirements.

title: Agentic AI for SAGIN Resource Management_Semantic Awareness, Orchestration, and Optimization
workflow: Semantic rewards to RL placement/resource solving
workflow_detail: SAGIN semantic manager; RL controller and resource solver. Semantic analysis shapes RL rewards; task placement/routing feeds continuous resource solving; command generation has a separate architectural scope.
evidence_note: Performance results cover the resource case study; command generation remains architectural.

title: WirelessBench: A Tolerance-Aware LLM Agent Benchmark for Wireless Network Intelligence
workflow: Tool-assisted wireless allocation and QoS decisions
workflow_detail: Wireless allocation/feasibility assistant. Tool-augmented agents produce slice, CQI, bandwidth, throughput, mobility-conditioned allocation, and QoS decisions.
feasibility_detail: The agent compares predicted throughput with a service minimum to produce the scoped QoS verdict; this remains part of the task being evaluated.
evidence_note: Benchmark scoring uses a tolerance criterion. Mobility/CQI dependency errors can propagate into the final QoS verdict.

title: Intent-Driven 6G Service Orchestration: Grounded Translation, Validation, and Decomposition
coverage_check: Catalog layer: supplied-profile match; greedy coverage
workflow_detail: TMF-style intent/service-management boundary. Catalog discovery and RDF construction feed requirement extraction, minimum-cost CFSS choice, and RFSS coverage/decomposition.
feasibility_detail: RequirementCapability predicates test all extracted requirements against profile capabilities; SHACL separately validates RDF structure.
coverage_detail: The capability layer determines whether any current catalog profile satisfies requirements; RFSS decomposition covers requirements using a greedy heuristic compared with CP-SAT.
evidence_note: Coverage is evaluated against supplied catalog profiles and requirement predicates.

title: MOSS: End-to-End Dialog System Framework with Modular Supervision
workflow_detail: Network troubleshooting dialogue manager. Utterances update dialogue state, choose clarification/repair acts, and generate responses.
evidence_note: The network subset evaluates dialogue success in laptop-network troubleshooting.

title: MSADM: Large Language Model (LLM) Assisted End-to-End Network Health Management Based on Multi-Scale Semanticization
feasibility_check: LLM prompts: evidence and action checks
workflow_detail: Network health/diagnosis assistant. Anomaly/fault classification and semantic state summaries support root-cause reports and tc mitigation suggestions.
feasibility_detail: LLM prompts request evidence checks and constrained mitigation choices.
evidence_note: Mitigation outputs are suggested scripts.

title: LLMcap: Large Language Model for Unsupervised PCAP Failure Detection
workflow_detail: Packet-trace diagnostic monitor. Masked-language-model reconstruction errors drive call-failure and frame/chunk localization decisions.
evidence_note: Generative reconstruction is an internal signal; the retained diagnostic outputs are detection/localization labels.

title: Adapting Network Information into Semantics for Generalizable and Plug-and-Play Multi-Scenario Network Diagnosis
feasibility_check: Z3 component: rules; model: diagnostic report
workflow_detail: Network knowledge and diagnostic assistant. Semantic/symbolic descriptions and KG updates support diagnosis plans, anomaly decisions, and explanatory reports.
feasibility_detail: A Z3-assisted symbolic component reasons over represented network rules; the final diagnostic report remains a model output.

title: Leveraging Multi-Agent System (MAS) and Fine-Tuned Small Language Models (SLMs) for Automated Telecom Network Troubleshooting
workflow: Delegated telecom diagnosis and action planning
workflow_detail: Telecom troubleshooting orchestrator. Coordinator and planner delegate diagnostic work, parameterize actions, and assemble root-cause reports.
evidence_note: Human approval gates executable plans; grounding and format checks also appear in training.

title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data
workflow_detail: Network troubleshooting assistant. Runbooks, anomaly identification, reports, API arguments, summaries, branch decisions, and test IDs use different output interfaces.
evidence_note: ValidateSourceCoverage checks preservation of serialized machine-data content.

title: Cross-Domain Query Translation for Network Troubleshooting: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Privacy Preservation and Self-Reflection
workflow_detail: Cross-domain troubleshooting interface. Domain/intent classification and clarification precede anonymization, technical query translation, diagnosis, and user explanation.
evidence_note: Confidence scores trigger clarification; anonymization precedes diagnostic translation.

title: SADE: Symptom-Aware Diagnostic Escalation for LLM-Based Network Troubleshooting
workflow: Symptom probes to skill-based fault localization
workflow_detail: Symptom-driven network diagnostic agent. Initial probes and deeper scans establish symptoms; a fault index routes to a skill that localizes a canonical fault/device.
observation_detail: The diagnostic workflow checks ambiguous reachability with direct-IP probes and inspects lower-layer evidence before accepting apparently healthy higher-layer observations.
evidence_note: The agent performs skill-based interpretation at runtime. Verified fault injection prepares the benchmark.

title: PropLLM: Propagation-Aware Scene Reconstruction for Network Fault Diagnosis
workflow_detail: Propagation-aware network diagnostic model. Multimodal evidence produces a fault class and a generated root-cause/propagation chain.
evidence_note: Causal direction masks and timestamp biases constrain model reasoning.

title: Intent-Based Management of Next-Generation Networks: an LLM-Centric Approach
workflow: Multidomain intent translation to service descriptors
workflow_detail: Multidomain/domain intent handlers; NFV/RAN orchestrators. Language decomposition and translation form NSD/RAND descriptors for domain activation.
feasibility_detail: The architecture assigns structure, conflict, and predicted-resource feasibility checks to intent handlers before deployment.
evidence_note: Measured timing ends at descriptor translation. Validation mechanisms are proposed, and activation lies downstream.

title: Configtrans: Network Configuration Translation Based on Large Language Models and Constraint Solving
workflow: Parameter/command mapping to target CLI trees
workflow_detail: Cross-vendor configuration translator. Constraint solving maps parameters; reranking/LLM choice selects commands and keywords; view ordering constructs the target CLI tree.
feasibility_detail: CSP enforces command/parameter correspondence and consistent view structure within the translation problem.

title: Network CoPilot: Intent-Driven Network Configuration Updating for Service Guarantee
workflow_detail: Network configuration-update assistant. A graph-enriched language model constructs OSPF/BGP parameter-update descriptions from intent, configuration, topology, and link state.

title: Intent-Based Management for Open RAN: Intelligent Network Configuration Automation via Chatbot
workflow_detail: Chatbot intent handler; ONOS controller. Entity/intent extraction and dialogue acts produce NILE that is installed through REST or CLI.
evidence_note: ConflictResolver is planned for future implementation; the demonstrated path covers intent installation.

title: NetLLMBench: A Benchmark Framework for Large Language Models in Network Configuration Tasks
workflow: Command generation and probes in emulation
workflow_detail: Network configuration benchmark agent. Models generate device-command JSON, request ping probes, and repair malformed responses.
evidence_note: Syntax verification and network-emulator feedback evaluate generated commands.

title: Towards LLM-Based Failure Localization in Production-Scale Networks
workflow: Production alert diagnosis with operator assistance
workflow_detail: Production-network diagnostic copilot. Alert summaries and device anomalies/scores feed ranked root-cause explanations and operator-assisted incident localization.
evidence_note: Component timing, 24-hour API scopes, and operator-assisted resolution time are distinct evidence boundaries.

title: NetAssistant: Dialogue Based Network Diagnosis in Data Center Networks
workflow_detail: Dialogue-based network diagnosis. Entity normalization and intent matching select workflows that produce network-health/root-cause reports for on-call users.
evidence_note: Workflow diagnosis and on-call resolution have different endpoints. Control/data-plane verification modules remain proposed.

title: Intent-Driven Network Management with Multi-Agent LLMs: The Confucius Framework
feasibility_check: Parsers, dry runs and invariant validators
workflow_detail: Network-management workflow/DSL assistant. Confucius plans DAG/MOP workflows, selects blocks, generates topology/query DSL, and coordinates diagnostic tools.
feasibility_detail: Custom parsers, API/ORM dry runs, and graph-invariant validators provide task-specific feedback before use.
evidence_note: Retrieval filters stale documents; validators check specific DSL and network invariants.

title: Graph Structure-Enhanced Large Language Model for Optical Network Fault Diagnosis: An Explainable Alarm Root Cause Localization Approach
workflow: Alarm propagation graphs to root-cause diagnosis
workflow_detail: Optical-network alarm diagnostic assistant. Models construct event topology/propagation matrices; adjacency construction and root-cause localization use the resulting graph.
evidence_note: The model constructs a structured matrix that supports graph-derived root-cause explanations.

workflow: LLM-assisted learning for O-RAN slice allocation
workflow_detail: O-RAN slicing policy (LLM-augmented MARL). Critic-only and fuller LLM-assisted learning variants produce joint slice/UE resource-block allocation.
evidence_note: Training/critic assistance and per-action inference have separate evaluation scopes.

title: R-IBN: A reinforcement learning-based intent-driven framework for end-to-end service orchestration and optimization
workflow: Intent translation to learned service-chain placement
workflow_detail: Intent handler; service-chain orchestrator. Language translation and contradiction classification feed GNN-assisted DRL SFC placement/routing.
feasibility_detail: Embedding-similarity thresholds with KNN refinement flag intent-policy contradictions through a learned semantic check.
evidence_note: GNN state forecasts supply the input to placement and routing decisions.

title: CEGS: Configuration Example Generalizing Synthesizer
feasibility_check: CEGS: formal checks of encoded intent, topology and templates
workflow_detail: Configuration example retriever; formal synthesizer. Intent normalization/roles select examples and device mappings; templates are verified and symbolically completed.
feasibility_detail: CEGS combines a Batfish-derived syntax parser, Python local attribute validation, NetComplete-based global verification, and formal template filling.
evidence_note: Formal correctness is relative to encoded intent, topology, and templates. Timing covers the complete synthesis.

title: Nissist: An Incident Mitigation Copilot based on Troubleshooting Guides
workflow: Clarified intent to guide-based mitigation actions
workflow_detail: Incident mitigation copilot. Clarified intent selects troubleshooting-guide nodes and produces corrected diagnostic/mitigation actions.
evidence_note: The reviewed task is network connectivity; reported mitigation times aggregate mixed-cloud incidents.

title: A Holistic View of AI-driven Network Incident Management
workflow_detail: Network incident-management assistant (conceptual). A proposed pipeline ranks hypotheses, plans tests and interprets monitors, then recommends mitigation.
evidence_note: The paper proposes module roles and future verification research.

title: Towards Explainable Network Intrusion Detection Using Large Language Models
workflow_detail: Network intrusion detector and explanation layer. Llama/GPT variants classify flows and produce explanatory alerts in separate scopes.
evidence_note: The paper evaluates intrusion classification and explanations, and discusses inference limits for real-time detection.

title: FedLLMGuard: A Federated Large Language Model for Anomaly Detection in 5G Networks
workflow_detail: 5G network anomaly detector. A federated, adapted language model classifies traffic/log embeddings as normal or anomalous.
evidence_note: Detection metrics have defined endpoints. The reported attack-mitigation time lacks an operational definition and leaves the mitigation path unspecified.

title: Can Jev Make SRE Agents More Reliable?
workflow: Agent diagnosis with ranked tests and evidence gates
observation_check: Planner reads fresh snapshot; review: current failure
feasibility_check: Jev review: cause, restoration and durability
workflow_detail: SRE diagnosis/mitigation agent. The agent proposes hypotheses and read-only tests; Jev ranks the tests and reviews diagnosis and mitigation evidence; the agent runs tests and repairs.
observation_detail: jev_plan adds a fresh, bounded namespace snapshot before ranking; the diagnosis review requires evidence of a current application failure.
feasibility_detail: Each mitigation-review question must reach probability 0.70, covering whether the repair addresses the cause, restored functionality, and appears durable. Rejection returns the agent to planning.
evidence_note: Jev ranks only agent-proposed tests; a missing hypothesis cannot be recovered by ranking. Pass rate is measured; time-to-diagnosis is not.

title: OrchestRAN: Network Automation through Orchestrated Intelligence in the Open RAN
workflow: Request-driven model placement and xApp dispatch
coverage_check: Optimizer: request admission from catalog models
workflow_detail: Non-RT RIC orchestrator (rApp); near-RT RIC/DU control apps. A BILP selects ML/AI Catalog models and nodes; containers are dispatched as xApps/dApps, and DRL agents select scheduling/slicing policies.
feasibility_detail: Constraints enforce model performance, control-loop timescales, node resources, and connectivity to required input data; pruning removes infeasible model-node variables.
coverage_detail: A request is admitted only when deployed models provide all requested functionalities; the branching variant can accept requests on a subset of clusters.
evidence_note: Solver time comes from MATLAB/CPLEX simulation; the Colosseum prototype reports placement and network effects without orchestration timing.

title: Benchmarking Various ML Solutions in Complex Intent-Based Network Management Systems
workflow_detail: Intent-based orchestrator for an ICT supply chain. An NLP intent manager emits JSON intents, a policy configurator matches stored policies, and an SVD/SGD recommender estimates ML-technique performance on devices.
feasibility_detail: After configuring policies, the policy configurator checks conflicts before triggering the network controller; no implementation or evaluation is reported.
coverage_detail: The policy configurator checks whether the requested ML technique exists in the store and alerts the user when it does not; this check is described but not evaluated.
evidence_note: Evaluation covers recommender accuracy (normalized RMSE on AI-benchmark data); intent translation and policy configuration are architectural.

title: Bridging Language Models and Formal Methods for Intent-Driven Optical Network Design
workflow: Offline intent to planned optical network design
feasibility_check: CFG parser: structure; PDDL solver: deployment constraints
workflow_detail: Optical network design assistant (pre-deployment). LLM grammar translation and optical RAG feed LLM-generated PDDL problems over a manual domain; an LLM agent translates the plan into a design.
feasibility_detail: A Lark grammar parser validates structure and routes errors to automatic correction or user clarification; the PDDL solver plans under budget, latency, and protection constraints.
coverage_detail: When no plan satisfies the constraints, the solver reports infeasibility and the user receives feedback; the pipeline can fall back to disclosed LLM-only topology generation.
evidence_note: Case studies report 96.7% grammar-error detection, with 2 of 15 vague-value cases undetected. No deployed network state is measured.

title: BLINC: Context-Specific Causal Learning for Automated RAN Configuration
workflow: Offline causal priors to RAN power-control configuration
observation_check: BN conditions on current measurements; CPD updates
workflow_detail: Non-RT RIC rApps with CI/CD deployment. LLM-derived mandatory/prohibited edges constrain Bayesian-network structure learning; inference scores P0/target-SNR configurations applied over O1/O2.
observation_detail: Recommendation scores each candidate configuration given current measurements; incremental CPD updates use new data, and a past recommendation degrades for cell-edge users.
evidence_note: LLM constraints keep edges voted by more than half of independent runs and enter the structure score. Recommendation searches a predefined feasible configuration space.

title: Proving the Utility of Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Simulations: A Comprehensive Examination
workflow_detail: Cyber-simulation scenario generator. ChatGPT-4 generates YAML network configurations from templates or golden examples; validated scenarios feed LLM-synthesized Python attack agents.
feasibility_detail: Topological checks cover adjacency, bidirectional firewall consistency, vulnerabilities, and process mappings; configurations that fail or do not run in NASim are discarded.
evidence_note: Generated attack agents print their own compromise verdict without an independent check. Validity rates combine schema, topology, and NASim outcomes.

title: Performance Evaluation of Intent-Based Networking Scenarios: A GitOps and Nephio Approach
workflow_detail: GitOps reconcilers (Argo CD, Flux CD, ConfigSync) and the Nephio/Porch package orchestrator. Desired-state manifests pushed to Git are synchronized and deployed on Kubernetes; Nephio first hydrates intent packages.
observation_detail: Operators compare tracked desired states with runtime states and reconcile drift after webhook-detected pushes; ConfigSync synchronization reflects its polling period.
evidence_note: Intents are declarative manifests without language interpretation. The benchmark measures sync, deploy, and healthy times and resource use.
